title: Kissed Crunchy Japanese Lamb Skewers
description: Sweet and crunchy Japanese dish featuring lamb mince, perfect for a brunch mood, made in individual mini cocottes and cooked to perfection in a tandoor, following ayurvedic sattvic friendly principles
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together lamb mince, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic until just combined
Thread small amounts of the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Roll each skewer in panko breadcrumbs to coat, then sprinkle with sesame seeds
Place the skewers in individual mini cocottes and cook in the tandoor for 12 minutes
Remove the skewers from the tandoor and let rest for 2 minutes
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds and scallions if desired
